In Heritage Mountain, its share of the houses listed in Port Moody went from 8.7% in June to 7.4% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 4.2% to 2.6%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

items.t: Port Moody real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses and 5 condos and townhomes listed in Heritage Mountain. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Heritage Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 40% (a sellers’ market); condos and townhomes had 40% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Heritage Mountain from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses and 6 condos and townhomes sold in Heritage Mountain over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in July with 4 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is Heritage Mountain compared with the rest of Port Moody?
faq.a: In September 2026, Heritage Mountain held 7.4% of the 135 detached houses listed in Port Moody and 2.6% of the 192 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 66.7% of the 15 homes listed in Heritage Mountain and condos and townhomes made up 33.3%; of the 6 that sold, houses were 66.7% and condos and townhomes 33.3%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Heritage Mountain than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 11 to 10 (−9.1%) and condos and townhomes fell from 9 to 5 (−44.4%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
